# Points & grids

*Describes reflex-silverpoint-react 0.8.1, wrapping silverpoint 0.8.0.*

Each chart's own props, with the JS name the silverpoint MCP tools and the React docs use. The props
every chart shares (`data`, `title`, `height`, `ground`, `palette`, the events…) are in
[SKILL.md](../../SKILL.md#common-chart-props); the defaults and notes of each prop come from the
MCP's `get_chart`. In each example the rows live in a `rx.State` field passed as `data`.

<!-- generated:family -->

**5 charts:** [`scatter_chart`](#scatter_chart) · [`bubble_chart`](#bubble_chart) · [`heatmap_chart`](#heatmap_chart) · [`treemap_chart`](#treemap_chart) · [`activity_grid`](#activity_grid)

## scatter_chart

`scatter-chart` · `ScatterChart` · Points on two linear scales, optionally sized.

Its own props (the common ones are in [SKILL.md](../../SKILL.md#common-chart-props)):

| Python | JS | Type |
|---|---|---|
| `x_key` | `xKey` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` |
| `y_key` | `yKey` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` |
| `size_key` | `sizeKey` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` |
| `size_range` | `sizeRange` | `readonly [number, number]` |

```python
import reflex as rx
from reflex_silverpoint_react import scatter_chart


class State(rx.State):
    rows: list[dict] = []


def scatter_chart_view() -> rx.Component:
    return scatter_chart(data=State.rows, title="Scatter chart", id="scatter-chart")
```

The demo's first rows (read through the accessors' defaults), drawn when `data` is omitted:

```json
[{"x": 152, "y": 51, "size": 2}, {"x": 158, "y": 56, "size": 4}, {"x": 161, "y": 54, "size": 3}]
```

## heatmap_chart

`heatmap-chart` · `HeatmapChart` · Labelled rows of values, normalised against `scaleMax`.

Its own props (the common ones are in [SKILL.md](../../SKILL.md#common-chart-props)):

| Python | JS | Type |
|---|---|---|
| `label_key` | `labelKey` | `Accessor<string>` |
| `values_key` | `valuesKey` | `Accessor<readonly (number \| null)[] \| null \| undefined>` |
| `scale_max` | `scaleMax` | `number` |
| `column_labels` | `columnLabels` | `readonly string[]` |


## treemap_chart
